instruction: Record the blueprint-required baseline, method, raw serial and concurrent pilot runs, threshold, comparison, and performance verdict on the evaluated SHA; add focused qualification failure-propagation coverage and deterministic concurrent provider-failure evidence, then rerun the four declared checks.

findings.summary: The frozen evidence does not establish the required timing baseline or provide a serial-versus-concurrent pilot comparison, so the claimed reduction in patch-release elapsed time is unproven.

The added qualification-runner tests cover concurrency, dependency barriers, exclusivity, and result ordering, but do not exercise scenario failure propagation or prove that dependent/provider work remains unstarted after a prerequisite failure.

evidence_refs.lines: Added qualification tests exercise bounded concurrency, dependency barriers, report ordering, invalid concurrency, and exclusive latency scenarios, but no scenarioRunner rejection case.
